questions.question: What does Mahito do?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Aoi Todo vs. Mahito

answer.item: Mahito follows up breaking Yuji's spirit by battering the sorcerer's body into the ground until he's utterly defeated in both regards

questions.question: Who arrives?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Aoi Todo vs. Mahito

answer.item: Aoi Todo has arrived to save his best friend, and he believes that they are the exception to the aforementioned poem

questions.question: What does Yuji believe?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Aoi Todo vs. Mahito

answer.item: Yuji can't forgive himself and begins to believe people will die simply because he lives

questions.question: What does Todo activate?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Aoi Todo vs. Mahito

answer.item: Todo activates Boogie Woogie to switch Arata's position on the ground behind him with Mahito's position in the air

questions.question: What does Yuji use?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Aoi Todo vs. Mahito

answer.item: He unleashes Black Flash and shatters Mahito's blocking arm, sending the cursed spirit reeling

questions.question: What does Mahito create?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Aoi Todo vs. Mahito

answer.item: By combining souls with weak rejection, Mahito spawns an uncanny transfigured human known as a Polymorphic Soul Isomer

questions.question: What does Mahito decide to activate?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Aoi Todo vs. Mahito

answer.item: The special grade decides that it's all-or-nothing and activates a Domain Expansion of 0.2 seconds

questions.question: What does Mahito do to Yuji?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Aoi Todo vs. Mahito

answer.item: Mahito punches Yuji from behind and knocks him to the ground before proceeding to rush Todo

questions.question: How does Yuji win?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Aoi Todo vs. Mahito

answer.item: Yuji punches Mahito in the side of his sternum and sends the cursed spirit flying from the impact

questions.question: Who does Yuji confirm this is?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Aoi Todo vs. Mahito

answer.item: Yuji hears Mahito call the newcomer "Geto" and takes notice of his attire, confirming to him that this must be Satoru Gojo's captor

questions.question: What does Geto do?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Aoi Todo vs. Mahito

answer.item: Geto ignores Yuji's demand and instead begins talking about the mysterious connection between catfish and earthquakes during the Edo Period

questions.question: What does Geto claim?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Aoi Todo vs. Mahito

answer.item: Pseudo-Geto claims that the original Suguru Geto would've defeated Yuta Okkotsu if his curses were not split between Shinjuku and Kyoto during the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons
